metadata.report_name: Person 2 Final Completion & Research Handoff Report

deliverables_summary.git_cleanliness: CLEAN (no merge conflicts, no whitespace errors, large weights ignored)

chronos_2_benchmark_decision.rationale: Chronos-2 is statistically significantly inferior to the positive drift baseline (p=0.0100) and compact XGBoost v3 (p=0.0328), has higher regression error (0.017502 vs 0.016374), and imposes 140x higher latency (141.7 ms vs <1 ms).

discrepancy_resolved.description: Gross PnL Rs 4,82,185 vs Net PnL Rs 4,09,700 with Rs 200 reported fees left an unexplained Rs 72,500 gap.
discrepancy_resolved.root_cause: A flat 15% STCG tax was subtracted from trading gains without displaying a tax column in the summary table, and failed to recognize the 693-day holding period as Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG).

research_components_verified.causal_feature_pipeline: Verified strictly point-in-time; zero future lookahead.
research_components_verified.transparent_regime_detector: Emits Interface Contract B ModelPrediction; 4 explicit market regimes.
research_components_verified.xgboost_regression_v1: 12/16 features; native booster with schema parity validation.
research_components_verified.compact_classifier_v3: 6 robust features; 51.93% test accuracy; strict parameter controls.
research_components_verified.gbdt_baseline_v1: Zero-dependency pure Python GBDT for offline fallback.
research_components_verified.embargo_splits: Purged embargo gap enforced between chronological splits.
research_components_verified.selective_prediction: Regime-gated Policy A and Uncertainty Policy B documented with coverage trade-offs.
